{
  "decision-date-a-legend-reading-between-proofs": "WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT i.impression_id, n.reading, n.source_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY i.impression_id
           ORDER BY n.note_day DESC, (n.plate_code IS NOT NULL) DESC, n.source_id COLLATE BINARY ASC
         ) AS rn
  FROM impressions AS i
  LEFT JOIN proof_notes AS n ON n.glyph = i.glyph
    AND n.note_day <= i.print_day
    AND (n.plate_code IS NULL OR n.plate_code = i.plate_code)
)
SELECT impression_id, reading, source_id
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY impression_id",
  "decision-dead-heat-purse-apportionment": "WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT squad, official_ms,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY official_ms) AS finish_place,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY official_ms) AS tie_size,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY official_ms ORDER BY squad COLLATE BINARY) AS tie_order
  FROM finish_log
  WHERE official_ms IS NOT NULL
), pools AS (
  SELECT r.official_ms, SUM(COALESCE(p.prize_cents, 0)) AS pool_cents
  FROM ranked AS r
  LEFT JOIN prize_slot AS p ON p.slot_no = r.finish_place + (r.tie_order - 1)
  GROUP BY r.official_ms
)
SELECT r.squad, r.finish_place,
       p.pool_cents / r.tie_size + (r.tie_order <= p.pool_cents % r.tie_size) AS payout_cents
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN pools AS p ON p.official_ms = r.official_ms
ORDER BY r.finish_place, r.squad COLLATE BINARY",
  "decision-dispatch-recovery-blocks": "SELECT a.offer_code AS a_code, b.offer_code AS b_code,
       a.fee + b.fee AS fee_cents,
       a.fee + b.fee - d.budget_cents AS over_budget_cents
FROM block_offer AS a
CROSS JOIN block_offer AS b
CROSS JOIN depot_limit AS d
WHERE a.vendor = 'A' AND b.vendor = 'B'
  AND a.crates + b.crates >= d.backlog
  AND a.hours_used + b.hours_used <= d.crew_hours
ORDER BY fee_cents, a.offer_code COLLATE BINARY, b.offer_code COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1",
  "decision-display-tray-stock-writedown": "SELECT m.shop_code, m.memo_day AS adoption_day,
       COALESCE(SUM(c.units_held * MAX(c.book_cents - c.recovery_cents, 0)), 0) AS write_down_cents,
       m.source_id
FROM shop_memo AS m
LEFT JOIN opening_count AS c ON c.shop_code = m.shop_code AND c.count_day = m.memo_day
WHERE m.action_code = 'launch'
GROUP BY m.shop_code, m.memo_day, m.source_id
ORDER BY m.shop_code"
}
